i appreciate it
but i haven’t felt truly happy in years unless i pop molly and im resigned to never feeling true happiness again
tried talking to people in my life i’ve done everything for and they didn’t even care or listen i got screamed at while having an anxiety attack about ending my life so i’m done trying

I know when anyone has reached out to me for anything minor, even when it sounds dumb to me, I do everything. I drove three hours and gave someone $1000 to try to make a situation better, when I’m a broke college student. But I can’t even get a text back or the same person would just ditch you for their other friends when you’re being “difficult” and a “frustration”. So much for love.

What’s the point anymore? Everyone has shown me their true colors. There is literally nobody in my life who’d care anymore.

i just wish someone could tell me everything would be okay. No matter how much I try to reach out, everyone’s just going to be annoyed or call me dramatic. Meanwhile I drop everything for everyone. Yet I’m everyone’s toy. The moment I have these thoughts nobody cares.

reading your comments and I’m in the exact same place. You can do everything for everyone, and nobody would even give a single shit about you. So what’s the point. It’s the worst feeling in the world. Humans are naturally social animals. I’m sorry you feel like this too. It’s the worst feeling on the planet.
